about: Drachenfels district outlines in world block coordinates [x, z], drawn along the city's seams: the north-south avenue (x ~20), the cross street at the fountain square (z ~-1030), the street behind the harbour (x ~128), the curved road bounding the wooden west quarter (x ~-95) and the street north of the harbour basin (z ~-1250). A building belongs to the district holding its centre. Edit and re-run 'python -m buildimport survey ... --districts' to re-measure.

districts.name: Harbour
districts.note: quay, dock terraces, three piers with moored ships

districts.name: North Shore
districts.note: terraces on the north-east bend of the coast

districts.name: Castle Quarter
districts.note: keep with gardens at the head of the avenue, merchant terraces

districts.name: West Lower Town
districts.note: small wooden houses, pond and stream

districts.name: Old Core
districts.note: large terraces between the curved road and the avenue

districts.name: Rotunda Quarter
districts.note: round courtyard building and its terraces

districts.name: Cathedral Quarter
districts.note: cathedral, its close and the fountain square

districts.name: Fishermen's Shore
districts.note: small wooden houses down to a natural shore
